# WeMind

> WeMind turns a personal WeChat account into an I/O channel for AI agents. It ships two mutually exclusive forms: an MCP server (`@wemind/wechat-mcp`) that any MCP client can drive, and a daemon CLI (**`@wemind/cli`**, command `wemind`) that long-polls WeChat itself, calls a resident ACP agent as its "brain", and replies automatically. Same bot token = one consumer only.

## Agent integration

- [docs/接入其它-ACP-Agent.md](docs/接入其它-ACP-Agent.md): generic ACP brain guide.

- [docs/接入-Qoder.md](docs/接入-Qoder.md): Qoder CLI integration — preset, sandbox `settingsBase`, `.auth` credential sync, M0–M3 measurements (images, dynamic MCP, worker interrupt/resume, memory inheritance).
- [docs/接入-Cline.md](docs/接入-Cline.md): Cline CLI integration — native `cline --acp`, sandbox `CLINE_DIR`/`CLINE_MCP_SETTINGS_PATH`, providers.json sync, custom-provider auth (`CLINE_PROVIDER`+`CLINE_API_KEY`), 3.0.74 measurements.
- [docs/接入-ClaudeCode.md](docs/接入-ClaudeCode.md): Claude Code via `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` (global install, Node ≥22) — `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` sandbox, `mcpViaAcp`, `bypassPermissions`, probe results plus a real WeChat single-turn E2E (2026-10-31); restart-continuity/MCP/task re-checks pending.
- [docs/接入-Codex.md](docs/接入-Codex.md): OpenAI Codex via the official `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` adapter — probe results plus real E2E on both worker and brain channels (2026-11-01); stdio MCP unsupported, no sandbox config dir (cwd only).
- [docs/接入-Gemini.md](docs/接入-Gemini.md): Gemini CLI native ACP (`--acp --approval-mode yolo --skip-trust`, 0.66.0) — `.gemini` sandbox, settings-based MCP, `replayOnLoad`, `--model` startup arg; probe + real E2E (single turn, restart `session/load`, hot switch, worker) on 2026-11-01.
- [docs/接入-pi.md](docs/接入-pi.md): pi coding agent via the community `pi-acp` adapter (plus the `pi` runtime) — `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` sandbox, `mcp.json` MCP, `quietStartup`; probe + real E2E (brain, hot switch, WeChat task) on 2026-11-01.
- [docs/ai/recipes/add-acp-agent.md](docs/ai/recipes/add-acp-agent.md): add a preset + capability adaptations.
- [docs/ai/recipes/add-mcp.md](docs/ai/recipes/add-mcp.md): MCP catalog/activation/transport.

## Install

- `npm i -g @wemind/cli` → command `wemind` (package name ≠ command name).
- `npx -y @wemind/wechat-mcp` → MCP server (binary `wemind-mcp`).
- `npx -y @wemind/cli <cmd>` works too; plain `npx wemind` does NOT (name mismatch).
- Release process: [docs/发布-wemind-npm.md](docs/发布-wemind-npm.md).

## Code map

- `packages/wechat-ilink-core/`: iLink HTTP client, types, errors, session guard, account/state, image crypto. Private, bundled into the published packages.
- `packages/wechat-mcp/`: MCP server with 6 tools. Published as `@wemind/wechat-mcp` (bin `wemind-mcp`).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/`: daemon, ACP brain, worker, CLI. Published as `@wemind/cli` (bin `wemind`).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/brain-agents.ts`: `ACP_AGENT_PRESETS`, `resolveAgent()`, `agentProblem()`.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/acp-brain.ts`: resident ACP client (brain).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/worker-acp.ts`: resident ACP client (worker).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/mcp-sandbox.ts`: brain sandbox + MCP activation.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/index.ts`: message routing, turn orchestration, progress budget.

## Commands

- `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`.
- `npm run check:version` (package name + version consistency), `npm run verify:publish`.
- `wemind list` / `wemind brain <key>` / `wemind brain check <key>` (installed CLI)
- `node packages/wechat-daemon/dist/cli.js list` (same thing from source)
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/doctor.ps1`
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check-docs.ps1`
- `node scripts/acp-probe.mjs` (env: `ACP_BIN`, `ACP_ARGS`, `ACP_SHELL`, `ACP_HOME_ENV`, `ACP_HOME`, `ACP_MODEL`)

## Hard facts (2026-11-02)

- Published: `@wemind/wechat-mcp` and `@wemind/cli`. Never publish `@wemind/wechat-ilink-core` (private, inlined).
- Package name ≠ command name: `@wemind/cli` installs the `wemind` binary. `npx` must use the package name.
- Process identity uses three marker sets (`proc-identity.ts`): `wemind` + `cli.js` (npm install and absolute repo path), `wechat-daemon` + `dist` + `cli.js` (running from the repo root with a relative path), and `run-daemon.ps1` (source-checkout wrapper). `wechat-daemon` alone is never sufficient — the published package directory is `@wemind/cli`.

- Default brain selection is `auto`: `pi → kiro → opencode → gemini → deepseek → qoder → cline`; persisted in `<data>/brain.json`. `pi` is preferred first but is only auto-probed when both `pi-acp` and the `pi` runtime are on PATH; `claude-code` and `codex` are never auto-probed — select them explicitly.
- `session/load` is not universal. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 returns `-32601`; it has `session/resume` instead.
- Session maps are namespaced per brain: `brain-sessions.json` keyed `<agent>:<userId>`, `worker-sessions.json` keyed `<agent>:task-<编号>@<userId>` (one session per task, so a restarted task keeps its own context); legacy bare keys migrate to the current brain on first read (`session-map.ts`).
- DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 advertises `promptCapabilities.image:false`; image prompts fail with `-32602`.
- Qoder CLI 1.1.78 has load/resume/images/MCP and needs `.auth/user` + `.auth/machine_id` synced into the sandbox; its sandbox MCP lives in `settings.json.mcpServers`.
- Cline CLI 3.0.74 has native ACP (`cline --acp`), `loadSession` (context survives a hard kill via `session/load`), but **no image input** (it advertises `image:true` yet ACP `prompt` keeps only text blocks, so the preset is `images:false`). Its ACP auth only restores `cline`/`cline-pass`/`openai-codex`; custom providers require `CLINE_PROVIDER`+`CLINE_API_KEY`. It ignores ACP `session/new.mcpServers` — MCP goes through `CLINE_MCP_SETTINGS_PATH` (`{mcpServers}`), and `session/close` is not implemented.
- Claude Code needs the official adapter `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` (global install, Node ≥22; Windows `claude-agent-acp.cmd`). Its sandbox uses `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (also isolates `~/.claude.json`), MCP goes via ACP `mcpServers`, and approvals are bypassed with `session/set_mode bypassPermissions`. Probe-verified plus a real WeChat single-turn E2E; restart-continuity/MCP/task re-checks pending.
- Codex needs the official adapter `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` (global install; Windows `codex-acp.cmd`). It has no sandbox config dir — only cwd points at the sandbox root; `load`, images, `set_mode`, and `set_config_option(model)` work, but stdio MCP does not (`mcpCapabilities.acp=false`), so the preset keeps `mcpViaAcp: false`. Probe-verified plus real E2E on both worker and brain channels (2026-11-01); image / cold-restart / switch-back re-checks pending.
- Gemini is a native ACP preset (`gemini --acp --approval-mode yolo --skip-trust`, 0.66.0). Sandbox is `GEMINI_CLI_HOME` with config under `<sandbox>/.gemini`; MCP lives in that `settings.json` (`settingsBase` strips only `mcpServers`), and credentials mirror `.env` plus Google OAuth files. `session/set_config_option` is unsupported (`modelArg: "--model"`); `session/load` returns before it finishes replaying history, so `replayOnLoad` waits for frame quiet. Probe + real E2E (single turn, restart `session/load` without history leak, hot switch, worker) passed 2026-11-01.
- pi needs both `npm i -g pi-acp` and `npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` (the preset's `requiresBins: ["pi"]` reports a missing runtime early). Sandbox is `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` at the sandbox root; MCP is pi's own `<sandbox>/mcp.json` (kiro shape, `mcpViaAcp: false`); no approval switch needed. Probe + real E2E (brain single turn, hot switch both ways, WeChat `任务 pi：…`) passed 2026-11-01. `pi-acp` still reads `~/.pi/pi-acp/session-map.json`, `~/.pi/agent/prompts`, `~/.agents/skills` from the real home.
- Qoder's user memory lives in `~/.qoder/memory/` and is junctioned into the sandbox (brain writes land in the real dir); `skills/agents/commands/AGENTS.md` do not exist in 1.1.78. Qoder Desktop may register MCPs in `~/.qoder/mcp-router.json` instead of `settings.json`, so those are intentionally invisible to `列出 MCP`.
- The repo has no `Brain` interface; `acp-brain.ts` exports `askBrain`/`newSession`/`restart`.
- iLink consecutive send limit is ~10; progress messages consume it.
- Windows `.cmd`/`.bat` agents must be launched through a shell; `binWin` must match the real filename (e.g. `dsh.cmd`).
